title: He Sold 10% of Apple for $800 🍎 #shorts
description:
In 1976, Ronald Wayne co-founded Apple with Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak and owned 10% of the company. He drew the first logo and wrote the partnership agreement - then, 12 days later, sold his share for $800 because he feared being personally liable for the company's debts. He has said he doesn't regret it.

Read more: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ronald_Wayne
